meta.title: Extend AI — Enterprise + WP AI
meta.description: Demo: the WordPress AI plugin plus the Extend AI Enterprise governance layer — policy preamble, versioned prompt overrides, rate limits, and output moderation — with a draft post and sample policy pre-seeded.
meta.author: alansmodic

Avoid jargon and superlatives.\nUse sentence case for headings." ); // Governance knobs, set low/visible so the demo can actually trip them. update_option( 'extend_ai_rate_limits', array( 'minute' => 5, 'day' => 100 ) ); update_option( 'extend_ai_banned_phrases', array( 'guaranteed results', 'miracle cure' ) ); update_option( 'extend_ai_redact_pii', true ); // A per-ability override so Tools -> AI Prompts and the preview page have something to show. if ( class_exists( '\\ExtendAI\\Enterprise\\Storage\\Prompt_Library' ) ) { ( new \ExtendAI\Enterprise\Storage\Prompt_Library() )->put( 'ai/title-generation', 'append', 'Keep the title under 60 characters. No clickbait, no superlatives.', 0 ); }
